origine_fr: Le Shuowen jiezi glose 辮 par « entrecroiser » : 糸, le fil, et 辡 pour le son. On lit 纟 serré entre deux 辛, qui forment 辡. 辡 se lit biàn, comme 辫, la tresse qu'on noue en croisant les mèches.
origine_en: The Shuowen jiezi glosses 辮 as “to interlace”: 糸, thread, and 辡 for the sound. You read 纟 squeezed between two 辛, which form 辡. 辡 is read biàn, like 辫, the braid made by crossing strands.

phrase.pinyin: Tā yǒu liǎng tiáo cháng biànzi.
